chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He whose deeds accord (him) a back position cannot be given a front position because of his lineage.
ai.seo_question: Does noble lineage guarantee high status in Islam?
ai.summary: In this famous maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) contrasts the static nature of inherited lineage (nasab) with the dynamic merit of righteous deeds (amal), emphasizing that spiritual elevation is earned rather than inherited. This reflects the Shia scholarly principle that true nobility is defined by piety and action, a concept deeply rooted in the Quranic verse 'Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you' (49:13).
